notes.title: 🔥 SOAI V0.11.0 🔥
notes.notes:
[h1][b]Added[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Inventory and item display.
[*] Consumption of food-type items.
[*] Character needs, time update with current action and weather taken into account.
[*] Game engine updated to Unity 6.
[*] Damage management during the encounter with the monkeys: the narration takes into account the damage suffered and displays different texts.
[/list]
[h1][b]Improved[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Collection quest now correctly takes into account items owned by the player.
[*] Quest sound.
[*] Fmod plugin and SplashScreen Sprite.
[/list]
[h1][b]Fixed[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] A few situations with monkeys have been improved in the layout.
[/list]
[h1][b]Missing[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Credits
[/list]
[h1][b]Issues[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Excessive game weight due to third-party plugin imports.
[*] Navigation causes agent to overrun destination.
[/list]

notes.title: Ouverture des playtests Steam
notes.notes:
🎉 [b]Great news from Awesome Game Concepts![/b] 🚀

We're delighted to announce that Steam playtests of our latest game, "Stranded On An Island", are now open to the first 100 lucky testers! This is your opportunity to take a sneak preview into a fascinating universe and actively participate in improving our creation.

These playtest sessions are crucial for us, as your feedback and impressions will directly influence the final stages of development. Your voice counts enormously in this creative process!

🔑 [b]How can you take part?[/b]

Go to our Steam page and click on "Request access" for the playtests.
Places are limited: only the first 100 registrants will be able to take part.
Share your impressions, suggestions and enjoy a unique gaming experience.

📣 [b]Share your feedback on our dedicated Discord server![/b]
Feedback and discussions will take place on our Discord server: [url=https://discord.gg/SS9ZQ5Bmsx]https://discord.gg/SS9ZQ5Bmsx[/url].

Ready for the adventure? Join us in this key stage and help us shape the game of your dreams! 🏝️
